crime: A courtyard branch tore the cuff of {WITCH_NAME}'s issued coat. A girl who enjoyed mending agreed to repair it at a dining-hall table that afternoon.

{WITCH_NAME} held the sleeve flat and passed thread while the girl stitched and answered her without lifting her eyes from the cuff, needle, or seam. After hours together, {WITCH_NAME} expected the girl to know her.

When the work was done, the girl handed her the coat and asked her to return it to its owner. She said it was hers and that she had sat across the table all afternoon. The girl admitted she had never looked up long enough to learn her face.

That evening, prisoners found the girl dead beside a lounge sofa, with one deep sword wound in her chest and a lounge sword beside her. Fresh burns crossed both palms where the handle had touched them.

The repaired cuff was scorched and missing a piece. A matching blackened scrap was caught across the front of the guard. When its torn edge was matched to the cuff, one blood smear and one deep crease continued across both pieces.

{WITCH_NAME} admitted that the girl had drawn the sword during an argument and that she had heated the handle until the girl let go. She claimed she left the girl alive and that someone else later used the sword.

The palm burns showed that heat had spread through the handle while the girl held it. More decisively, the continuous smear and crease showed that the cuff was still attached to her sleeve and folded across the guard when the guard struck the bloodied chest around the wound; the cloth tore only afterward.

{WITCH_NAME} had stared at the exposed end until the girl dropped the sword. Before the handle cooled, she wrapped her repaired cuff around it, picked it up, and drove it into the girl's chest. Pulling the blade free tore the scrap from her sleeve and left it on the guard.
fields.epitaph: The nearest eye was carved in stone, where no gaze had ever lived.
execution: An enormous stone eye, carved with an iris and pupil, rolls straight at her. It knocks her flat on her back and continues over her body, pressing its full weight across her shoulders, ribs, and chest. When it rolls away, her ribs and chest are crushed, and she lies dead on the execution stand.

magic.name: Heating Stare
magic.text: She can heat anything by staring at it, and the longer she looks, the hotter it gets.
